system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The Hebi Clan has spent generations cultivating their clans special breed of serpent and using its hyper potent venom to further enhance their clans station. The Hebi have developed a special organ that stores their Viper Blood. This organ with training, can be manipulated to express a series of techniques only possible for the Hebi called Venom Arts. The first of which all Hebi has is their ability to metabolize it to suppress extreme conditions they may experience.

If you end your turn with ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, to make a Constitution saving throw vs a DC 15 + 1 for each Physical or Elemental condition rank you have. On a success, you remove 1 rank of an aforementioned condition.

You know one Venom Art of your choice, gaining an additional Venom Art at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If a Venom Art inflicts Virulent, it lasts until the beginning of your next turn unless otherwise stated. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute.

Venomous Refresh

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 2 Viper Blood forcing it to cycle through your mind, washing over your brain and nervous system. When you do, select one Mental or Sensory condition you currently have, reducing its ranks by 2, except for the Sealed condition.

Venomous Regeneration

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend multiples of 2 Viper Blood, up to a max of 10. When you do, you roll 1 Hit die for every 2 Viper Blood spent. This does not spend your rolled hit die. You regain hit points equal to the result.

Venomous Augmentation

As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Viper Blood, to circulate it throughout your muscles, having it act as a potent stimulant. Until the end of your next turn;

Your speed is increased by +10. This is increased by +10 at 7th and 15th levels.

Strength and Dexterity Checks you make gain a rank of Mastery. This increases to two ranks at 7th and 15th level.

Suppress the effects of Physical conditions you have for the duration.

Coiling – Black Mamba

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a black mambas black maw striking with deadly precision. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your weapons range, you can make a Mamba Strike.

Mamba Strike. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, roll your [Weapon Damage], recording the result. First, reduce the triggering damage you would take by the result. Then, the triggering creature takes the recorded [Weapon Damage] and forces them to make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 20 feet away from the Hebi on a failure. By spending 1 Viper Blood, if the triggering creature fails this saving throw, you can move up to half your speed. If you end this movement within weapon range of the them, you can make one additional weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit and inflicting them with Virulent. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Mamba Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Coiling – Silver Cobra

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a Silver Cobras opened hood coiling around your weapon, striking in unison. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action or opportunity attack, you can instead make a Cobra Strike.

Cobra Strike. Make a Weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit. Then, you can move 10 feet, spending your remaining movement. If this movement puts you within range of a different hostile creature, you can repeat this attack against them. You can repeat this movement and attack string, always targeting a creature you haven’t previously attacked as part of this Cobra strike, until you run out of movement speed. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of each Cobra Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Coiling – Emerald Basilisk

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of an Emerald Basilisk coiling around you and your opponent like Jormungand the world serpent. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action or opportunity attack, you can instead make a Basilisk Strike.

Basilisk Strike. Make a Weapon attack comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within your weapons range, in a radius around you. If the target creature(s) has ranks of Envenomed or Virulent, treat their AC as -2 lower to determine if you score a hit. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to target creatures on a hit. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Basilisk Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Serpents Cloud

As an Action, by spending 2 Viper Blood, you can exhale cloud of aerosolized venom, into either a 20-foot radius, centered on you, or a 30-foot cone originating from you. All creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 3d6 poison damage and become Virulent, or half as much damage on a success. Increase damage by +2d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Beginning at 11th level, creatures with ranks of Bleed suffer a -1 penalty to their saving throw for every rank they have.

Serpents Bite

As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you elongate your fangs like that of a snakes and gain the Serpents Bite, until the beginning of your next turn.

In place of an attack made as part of the Attack Action, Opportunity attack or a Hijutsu you cast; you can make a Serpent Bite allowing you to use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility.

Serpent Bite. Make an unarmed attack, dealing 3d6+your modifier in Poison damage on a hit, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failure. Increase the damage of this Bite by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Also increase the ranks of Envenomed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Virulent Blood

Once per turn, when you begin your turn with at least one rank of Envenomed, you can reduce one of the aforementioned conditions ranks by 1. When you do, you regain 2 Viper Blood as your body converts it into fuel for you.

Beginning at 11th level, if you have ranks of Envenomed you ignore its effect preventing you from regaining hit points and its ranks do not count against your hit point regeneration from the Serpent Blood clan feature. Instead, increase the amount of hit points you regain from your Viper Blood clan feature, by +2, for every rank of Envenomed you have.

Virulent Infusion

As part of casting a Ninjutsu, or a Bukijutsu using a weapon from the Blade Group, you can spend 1 Viper Blood. If you do, on a failed save, in place of one condition the jutsu inflicts, you can inflict the Virulent condition following the jutsu’s normal rules. If the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then force one affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs jutsu’s save DC, becoming Virulent on a failure.

If you spend 3 Viper Blood as part of the aforementioned jutsu disciplines casting, then you can inflict both Virulent condition and the jutsu’s original condition. Also, if the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then you can force all affected creatures to make the Constitution saving throw, gaining the Virulent condition, on a failure.
